next_step: Closed - lost to competitor. Re-engage after FY25 budget refresh (Q3 2025)
notes:
Stage summary: late-stage procurement but ultimately closed-lost to Replicate/Together bundle.

History & timeline (chron):
- 2024-10-01: inbound MQL -> AE Samira assigned. initial discovery call. heavy focus on EU data residency and on-prem requirement.
- 2024-10-15: product demo (ff_2024-10-15_emerald_intro). demo audience: Head of AI (Markus), Infra lead (Asha), SecOps (Tom).
- 2024-11-05: POC kickoff agreed (2-week prototype) — environment: staging VPC + sample PII-sanitized dataset. SE Diego to manage.
- 2024-11-19: mid-poc check-in; showed 30% cost win with Redwood batching profile vs baseline, latency 120ms median for 512 tokens. Fireflies link above.
- 2024-12-02: Security review opened. Asked for SOC2 cert, KMS integration docs, network topology for private deployment. Raised ticket SEC-4127.
- 2024-12-20: Procurement signals competitor evaluation intensifying. Together offering all-in monthly bundle + on-prem licensing discount via reseller. Replicate offered faster on-prem installer and lower license fee for model ops.
- 2025-01-08: Final security deep-dive call with SecOps — outstanding ask: HSM/KMS flow diagrams + legal addendum for data residency. Drive doc shared.
- 2025-01-12: Emerald informs AE: internal budget freeze for FY25 Q1; vendor decision paused. Later same day procurement confirms they accepted Replicate's offer for pilot (cheaper up-front, existing vendor relationship).

Primary requirements & evaluation notes:
- Workloads: heavy reranking (batch), embeddings index for search, chat support for internal ops.
- Latency target: p95 < 200ms for 512 token inference on dedicated nodes. Throughput peak ~1200 reqs/min for reranking batch jobs.
- Compliance: must run in EU-only infrastructure, SOC2 + SSO/SAML, KMS/HSM support, audit logs tied to user ids.
- Ops: wanted canary rollouts and automatic fallback to smaller LLMs during spikes.

Why we lost (recorded reasons):
- Pricing & commercial: Replicate + reseller priced on-prem bundle ~30% cheaper in year 1; Emerald prioritized capex constraints and lower up-front.
- Existing relationship: Procurement had prior engagement with Replicate reseller, faster procurement path.
- Security/compliance friction: Emerald's legal required HSM diagrams and additional contractual language; timeline slipped while legal chased vendor answers. Competitor provided ready-made addendum.
- No internal champion: primary sponsor (Head of AI) changed teams mid-POC; new sponsor less committed -> momentum lost.

Sales notes / AE/SE observations:
- SE Diego: POC performance validated our batching strategy but customer placed disproportionate weight on immediate license cost and reseller convenience.
- AE Samira: Procurement pushed for 'one vendor to close quickly' — Redwood's longer legal turnaround hurt. Need faster legal templates for on-prem + reseller scenarios.

Next steps for Redwood CRM:
- Mark as closed-lost, reason: competitor (Replicate) + budget freeze.
- File security artifacts used (drive links) and timeline.
- Set re-engage reminder Q3 2025 post-budget cycle — target conversation: TCO over 3 years and migration incentives.

Short quote from final call: "We like Redwood's perf numbers but we can't justify the up-front licensing delta and need the contract in this quarter. Replicate gave procurement a clean path."

Attachments & artifacts: pricing deck (drive), security FAQ, ff transcripts. Jira tickets SEC-4127 and POC-2331 contain technical logs.
